## Setting
Setting the membership fee structure. A club's running costs have shifted since the fee was last set, and the five people on the committee must fix the structure for the coming year. - Last year's ledger of outgoings
- Bank statements on last year's renewals
- Outgoing treasurer's logged hours
- Sign-up records for mid-year joiners
- Weekday turnout since the summer outings
- Quieter members at the winter social
- Tally of the sign-in sheets
- The rota against the attendance record
- Minute books from the named-grade years
- Taster evening forms from non-joiners

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Minato, Ryuji, Minako, May and Shunichi. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |
| 3 | everyone is told the options | 4 turns | every participant votes; the option with the most votes is adopted |
- Several participants may choose the same thing; what is found out is told only to the participant who looked into it.
If votes are tied, one of the tied options is chosen by a fixed rule. The discussion ends after the vote.

## Looking into things
After round 1, each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into. What they find out is told only to that participant.

Name: Shunichi
Age: 32
Gender: male
Personality: Shunichi is a very confident person who can remain calm in any situation. He is not modest, and has a slightly sarcastic side, but that is part of his charm. He is not sociable, but he is good at communicating at the right time and is relied upon by those around him. He rarely becomes overly emotional and can analyze situations calmly and act accordingly, so he has an unexpectedly rational side.
Concern: The same dozen faces are at everything while others pay the same and appear twice a year, and it is being said openly now rather than muttered. I would rather find out how uneven it actually is, and who is carrying the work, before we argue about it.
